test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of July 2022, under the Seekho aur Kamao (Learn and Earn) Scheme for skill development of minorities, what should be the age bracket of trainees?
solution:
The correct answer is __**14-45 years**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **14-45 years** is the age bracket for trainees under the **Seekho aur Kamao (Learn and Earn)** Scheme as of July 2022.
 
• The Seekho aur Kamao Scheme aims to provide skill development training to minority communities to enhance their employability and entrepreneurial skills.
 
• The scheme focuses on modern trades and ensures placements for at least 75% of the trained candidates, out of which 50% should be in the organized sector.
 
• The scheme is implemented through selected **Project Implementing Agencies** (PIAs) across the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Seekho aur Kamao Scheme is an initiative of the **Ministry of Minority Affairs**, Government of India.
 
• The scheme also aims to preserve and update the traditional skills of minorities and establish their linkages with the market.
 
• It includes soft skills, IT, and English language training as part of the curriculum.
 
• Special focus is given to women, with** 33% of the total beneficiaries being female candidates**.
 
• The scheme also includes a post-placement support system to ensure the sustainability of the employment provided.
